title: PORTAL SSID TOPOLOGY — Two-Door Architecture: Old Bridge + New Face
principle: iPhone escapes at 8-letter PIN. Next unit up is 'eco579163'. Aperture Science and Black Mesa keep the old password for IoT legacy. GAIA is the new door with eco579163. All ingest the old, binding hosts them ONTO GAIA.

old_door.purpose: IoT LEGACY BRIDGE — Nest, Alexa, Vizio, Chromecast, Epson, Xbox
old_door.metaphor: The old doors stay open for the creatures already inside

new_door.purpose: NEW PUBLIC FACE — unified organism access, phone, laptop, Frame
new_door.metaphor: The green door for new life. eco + PIN = organism + trust.

eco579163.who: Kevin, guests, new devices, Frame, phones
eco579163.note: iPhone needs 8+ chars — eco579163 = 9 chars, perfect

exoticpanda714.meaning: Legacy router password — unchanged since setup
exoticpanda714.who: Nest, Alexa, Vizio, Chromecast, Epson, Xbox, all IoT
exoticpanda714.note: These devices can't easily change WiFi passwords

ssid_meanings.aperture_science: WHITE portal (2.4GHz) — penetrating, IoT, sensors, old code
ssid_meanings.black_mesa: BLACK portal (5GHz) — dense, streaming, fast, legacy compute
ssid_meanings.gaia: GREEN portal (both bands) — organism face, new touch, public PIN

bridge_architecture.br_lan: main LAN — Aperture Science + Black Mesa devices
bridge_architecture.note: Both bridges resolve to the same flat subnet. Old and new coexist.

frame_status.note: Frame is on the NEW door — first device through the green portal
